verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents an inbound webhook URL that accepts external HTTP requests and starts a run with the payload. Routines mention only a generic 'schedule or trigger' with no webhook specifics, and the MCP items cover Lindy consuming external tools, not receiving HTTP callbacks. The axis clearly applies to an automation and agent product, so missing evidence means none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can expose a custom webhook URL that receives external HTTP requests and starts a workflow run with the payload
